tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'phags ma sgrol ma nyer gcig gi cho ga me tog pad dkar phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// gsung gi rdo rje tshe 'od snang ba dpag tu med// brtse chen dam bcas 'gro sgrol gnyen gcig 'jig rten mgon// 'phags mchog snying rjes 'gro la spyan ras gzigs pa yi// byams pa'i rnam rol rang gzugs sprul pa'i tshul snang ba// dus gsum rgyal kun skyed yum yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar// sgyu 'phrul cir yang 'char ba'i 'phags ma nyer gcig la// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lo ki shwa ras mngon du byin rlabs grub pa'i dbang thob pa// mi tra dzo ki thub bstan gsal ba'i nyi ma che// 'gro ba'i mun sel mgon khyod bla med snying po'i bar// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// paṇ+ḍi ta pa don yod rdo rje 'od srung mgon// mchog gzigs jo sras mnyam med byams pa seṅge'i mtshan// kun spangs rin chen shes rab g.yung ston badz+ra shrī// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mkhan po grags tshul mkhas shing grub pa chos dar ba// sangs rgyas dpal ba kirti shrī bha dra dang*// slob dpon rin chen kun dga' rab 'byams chos rje la// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rje btsun gtsug lag phreng ba dkon mchog yan lag zhabs// yongs 'dzin rnam rgyal dpal bzang ngag gi dbang po mchog /ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub rnam rgyal legs grub la// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// don gzigs phrin las shes rab ye shes rdo rje can// zab gter mnga' bdag grub dbang lā li ta badz+ra// 'jam mgon rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho gang de la// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// shes bya kun mkhyen gnas thob dharma ka ra dang*// bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon po bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog rnams la// gsol 'debs smin grol dngos stsol bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rtog tshogs lha yi dkyil 'khor ye shes rol par 'char// rig rtsal 'chi med rtag pa rdo rje'i gdeng thob nas// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mngon gyur 'gro ba rnams// sgrol ba'i yang dag rdzogs sangs go 'phang mchog brnyes shog

/ ces pa'ang 'phags ma'i dkyil chog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs thugs dam brgya rtsa ltar smin byed lam gyi brgyud pa bkod cing*/ gzhan du rje dgu pa badz+re shwa ra nas brgyud pa dang*/ jo nang rje btsun sogs nas brgyud pa ste/ brgyud pa gsum ldan byin rlabs kyi tshan kha rmad du gyur pa'ang shes bar bya'o// ༈ na mo gu ru ār+ya tā re bh+yaḥ srid zhi'i zur phud gser gyi pad+mos mngon par 'dud pa yi// gang zhig 'khor ba'i 'ching ba kun sgrol bcom ldan 'phags ma yum// khyod kyi zhabs pad ri bong 'dzin pa bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can// ji srid snying po'i bar du bde chen 'khor lor rtag tu rol// 'khor ba'i chu bo chu bzhis nyen pa rnams// dran pa tsam gyis mi 'jigs sbyin ba'i gter// yid la 'dod 'jo'i dpal stsol lhag pa'i lha'i// rmad byung phrin las snang ba spel bar bya// 'dir rje btsun ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs grub chen nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa las brtsams te khyer bder bkod par bya ste/ de yang slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i kun btus las/ dben pa'i gnas su ras bris sogs// mdun du mchod pa byas nas ni// sngags rnams bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'chi ba bslu ba 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ de yang spyir cho ga 'di la bdag mdun bum pa dbang rjes bcas rim lnga dang*/ de dag re re la yang bye brag nang gses su dbye bas don tshan so sor bkod pa las bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'dir spyi don lngas bsdus te bstan/ bye brag tu yan lag gi rnam grangs so sor phye nas bkod pa las/ dang po/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung nas 'di nyid kyi smin byed rgyud la 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsgrub par bya ste/ byang chub tshe dang dngos grub gzhan// ma smin pa las 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa dus ni rab bzhi'am/

rtag par yang rung ste/ dkar phyogs kyi snga char dge ba'i dus la brtsams te/ de yang thog mar bkra shis shing byin chags pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas byi dor legs par byas la/ gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rten 'byung mchod rdzas yo byad kyi rnam pa du mas phyogs kun tu brgyan pa'i dbus su rten byin rlabs can bkram pa dang*/ khyad par 'phags ma nyer gcig gi sku brnyan nam bris sku yang bshams/ stegs kyi khar rdul tshon rdor me'i rwa dkyil dang pad+ma 'dab ma rim pa gsum ldan dbus dang bcas pa la gtso 'khor so so'i rang mdog gi lha mtshan bkod pa'am/ ras bris sam yang na maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su 'bru dkar tshom bu dri bzang gis sbags pa rtsa sngags bzlas bzhin par so sor bkod/ de'i steng mañdzi'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dar dang me tog rin po ches kha brgyan pa/ kha rgyan dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa yang bshams/ dal 'bab rgyun gyis sum gnyis bkang zhing nyer lnga'i rdzas dang dri bzang yang btab/ las kyi bum pa dkyil 'khor byang shar du bshams/ lhor cod pan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ byang shar du ming dbang gi rdor dril sogs kyang bshams nas phyogs mtshams su nyer spyod la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag rnams dang*/ rin po che'i snod du zlum gtor dkar gsum gyis sbrus pa lnga tshom mthar mar gyi ril bus phyur bur 'gengs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bsangs chu sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du bar bgyid la/ nub ma yin par lho yi phyogs po ṭa la lta bur gdong phyogs la bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas khrus dang gtsang sbra bcas te/ bde bar 'dug la/ dang po/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad dkar dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ gnyis pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du kham̐ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa cir yang 'char ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin rlabs spel/ oṃ da sha dig lo ka pa la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe sogs/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ da sha dig lo ka pa la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ newi d+ya/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// sgrub la mngon par skyong ba yi// 'jig rten lha klu gnod sbyin dang*// gnas dang gzhi yi bdag po sogs// mthu chen 'byung po ma lus rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gang dag byang chub bsgrub pa yi// rnal 'byor nad gdon bar chad zhi// tshe bsod ye shes dpal 'byor rgyas// phyi nang snang srid dbang sdud cing*// dgra bgegs gnod byed rdul du rlog /'jig rten bde zhing 'bru nor 'phel// chos bzhin bsam don 'grub pa dang*// phrin las rgya chen bsgrub tu gsol// gnas 'dir lta bar mi dbang ba'i// nag po'i phyogs gyur log 'dren rnams// 'di ru ma 'dug dengs par gyis// gal te bka' 'das tho 'tsham na// khro bo'i rdo rje me char gyis// bgegs tshogs brlag gyur gdon mi za// oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa oṃ sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ gsum pa srung 'khor ni/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig gi 'od zer las grub ba'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi rang bzhin 'od zer kha dog drug pa dang*/ nang du me ri dkar po'i gur khang zlum por 'khyil ba yangs shing rgya che ba phyi nang bar mtshams thams cad ut+pal sngon po kha bye ma thag gis gang ba rab tu sra zhing brtan pa gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i srung ba'i 'khor los gtams par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgoms la/ de nas dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i nang du hūm̐ yig dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzhan yang rdo rje'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams gang ba zag med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las kyang ches cher lhag pa rgyun mi chad pa spro bar gyur/ ces brjod nas thal mo khong stong nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya ho/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te brjod la/ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ bdag dang 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can rnams// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus pa'i// gsang gsum ngo bo bcom ldan 'phags ma yum// khyod zhabs pad+mor sgo gsum skyabs su mchi// chags bral dam pa'i chos mchog pha rol phyin// brgyad khri stong phrag bzhi yi bden ba'i don// gsung gi rol pa rje btsun sgrol ma yum// khyod zhabs pad+mor dang bas skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi dam pa byang chub nges don gzhi// lung rtogs zab mo'i gnas la mtha' bral ba// dge 'dun bdag nyid 'jig rten mgon gyur ma// khyod zhabs pad+mor gus pas skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan rigs kun bdag po rdo rje can// byin rlabs rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam rgyud sde bzhi// dpa' po mkha' 'gro ye shes lha rab 'byams// phrin las chos skyong rgya mtsho 'dus pa yi// rtsa ba gsum dngos lhag pa'i lhar gyur ma// khyod zhabs pad+mor bla med snying po'i bar// mi phyed dad pas rtag par skyabs mchi'o//

lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ nyon mongs mun par byings ba'i 'gro ba rnams// bsgral phyir lhag bsam mkha' ltar dwangs ba la// rnam par grol ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar gyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par sems bskyed do// lan gsum/ oṃ bodhi tsit+ta u pa da ya a haṃ/ dang po tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas ba'i tām̐ yig dkar po las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad snang bar byas te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang po ṭa la yi zhing khams nas bla ma 'od dpag med rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa'i rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sras dang slob mar bcas pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūpe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shab+da/ sogs kyis mchod la/ gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyi// rgyan 'khor lnga yi bdag nyid can// bcom ldan 'phags ma'i lha tshogs la// bdag sogs 'gro kun phyag 'tshal 'dud// bde ba chen po zag med kyi// longs spyod 'dod dgu'i sprin bzang po// blo yis blangs te dngos 'byor dang*// yid sprul dag pa'i mchod pa 'bul// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// dug gsum nyon mongs dbang gyur pas// sdig pa bgyis dang bgyid stsal rnams// thams cad mthol zhing bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// 'phags pa nyan rang slob mar bcas// gzhan phan rmad byung dge ba'i stobs// dam pa'i rjes su yi rang ngo*// sems can ma brgal bsgral ba dang*// ma grol grol dang dbugs dbyung ba// yang dag lam la dkri ba'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rab 'byams zhing gi ston pa rnams// don dam 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// 'pho med rtag pa rdo rje'i sku// lhun gyis grub par bzhugs gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge ba'i chu rgyun gyis// 'gro drug duḥkha'i sgrib dag nas// sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa yi// myang 'das go 'phang thob phyir bsngo//

zhes yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par mos/ gsum pa tshad med bzhi sgom pa ni/ sems can bde dang bde rgyur ldan par shog /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rgyu dang bcas pa bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde bas 'bral med 'tsho ba dang*// nye ring bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med gnas gyur cig / ces lan gsum brjod nas/ rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag spangs te rtse gcig ba'i rgyun la mnyam par bzhag nas/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i sngags 'di'i byin gyis brlab bo// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma bhā wa shu d+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid du bltas nas dang po/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su bhūm̐ las dwangs bsil nor bu chu shel dkar po'i gzhal yas khang de yi dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po sdong bu yal ga ge sar mchog tu rgyas pa 'dab ma rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnyogs pa med pa nya gang ba'i gdan gyi steng du sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje chen pos sprul pa'i tām̐ yig dkar po gnas pa de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes mtha' dag 'phel bar byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo ston ka'i zla ba chu shel ltar dwangs shing 'tsher ba/ blta bas mi ngoms par rab tu mdzes pa'i spyan dkyus ring zhing zhi ba chen po'i 'dzum pa'i mdangs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis/

dbu la spyan gsum dang phyag zhabs bzhi yi mthil du yang spyan re re ste/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ltag par bcings pa'i lhag ma g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tshos sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi snye ma dang*/ lha'i gser gyi cod pan yid bzhin gyi nor bus spras pa'i dbu rgyan dang mu tig dkar po la sogs pa rin po che'i rnam pa du ma'i snyan cha/ mgul chu/ do shal/ se mo do/ dpung rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang bcas pa rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyis 'dod dgu ster ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas mtheb srin sbyar bas ut+pal dkar po 'dab ma mchog tu yangs pa'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de yang rtse mo gsum du gyes ba'i dbus kyi me tog 'dab brgya snyan drung du rgyas pa/ g.yas kyi rtse mor 'bras bu dang*/ g.yon gyi rtse mor kha ma bye ba bum par yod pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu'i dar gyi smad g.yogs rnam par bkra ba/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dri ma med pa'i 'od dang 'od dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de yi phyi rim la pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi dang*/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab ma bdun dang*/ de'i yang phyi rim la pad+ma 'dab ma bcu rnams kyi steng du mdun nas g.yas bskor du rim pa bzhin pad nyi zla ba'i gdan sogs re re la rang rang gi sa bon las skyes ba'i lha mo rnams su gyur pa ni/ oṃ las sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo me dpung 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis 'khor lo dang dung*/ bzhi pa gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa zhi ba'i nyams can chos 'byung la gnas pa/

tām̐ yig las dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma dkar mo dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis mnyam gzhag g.yas lhag mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'khor lo/ nor bu/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyi spyi blugs/ ut+pal/ dril bu/ bum pa/ po ti 'dzin pa/ re yig las gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bcu ma g.yas rnams kyi phreng ba ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug gu/ g.yon rnams kyis dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa/ t+yāta yig las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon spyi blugs dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// de yi phyi rim du tā yig las hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa'i sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa/ re yig las 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas zhags pa bsnams pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ tu yig las rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo na bza' ser po man bas pa/ drag mo dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas kyi thog ma 'khor lo/ phyi ma ral gri/ g.yon gyi thog ma pad+ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ phyi mas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs can/ re yig las dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dang pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis chu srin la gnas pa/ tām̐ yig las seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pala'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ swā yig las mya ngan med pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga me tog dmar po can 'dzin pa/ hā yig las phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma nag mo drag mo'i sku can g.yas gza' brgyad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon phongs pa sel ba'i lcags kyu zhags pa dang bcas pa bsnam pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de yi phyi rim du āḥyig las bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams thugs kar gtod pa'i rin po che/ lcags kyu/ dbyug gu/ bum pa bsnams pa/ bruṃ yig las yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo drag mo'i sku can zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ata yig las khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma mthing ga nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer bsdus shing bā su ta rol pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas rnams kyis ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ mgo rlon gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhing chen gyi gdan la 'gying ba/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i shing gi myu gu skyes pa/ ṇi yig las dge legs ster ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo phyag g.yas gsum na phreng ba/ mchog sbyin/ dbyug pa/ g.yon gsum na pad+ma/ ril ba/ po ti 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ yig las chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo phyag g.yas thugs kar rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 'phyar bas snying po dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

sha yig las bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ki yig las rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol bas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gnyis mchog sbyin dang glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bya ngang pa la gnas pa/ dza yig las sdug bsngal bsreg pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa/ cung zad g.yas brkyang bas sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ tse yig las dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phe yig las yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum ma phyag g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon mu tig gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas khyu mchog glang dkar po la gnas pa'o// de dag thams cad kyang lha'i gos sna tshogs pa'i dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes par spras shing sku'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal zhing 'od kyi snang bas phyogs bcur khyab par gyur/ lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang so so'i sa bon/ khyad par gtso mo'i thugs ka'i dbus su pad dkar dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar tām̐ yig dkar pos mtshan par gyur pa/ de dag rnams las 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lho phyogs ri bo po ṭa la dang*/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams nas bsgom pa dang 'dra pa'i rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sras dang slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ

zhes brjod la/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas// tām̐ yig ljang khu las 'khrungs shing*// tām̐ yig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od las byung ba'i dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ gtso mo la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ 'khor rnams la rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang*/ de nas bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ rdo rje'i mchod yon dwangs shing rgya mtshor 'khyil// zhabs bsil rab tu sim byed yid gar 'ong*// me tog sna tshogs rnam par bkra zhing brdal// bdug pa'i spos mchog ngad ldan sprin chen g.yo// snang gsal kun khyab 'od kyi zer mdangs 'tsher// dri chab byugs pa'i khyad par du ma dang*// zhal zas 'chi med bcud bzang ro brgyar ldan// rgyud mangs rol mo snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sogs// mchod pa'i bye brag rmad byung dam pa 'di// yid bzhin mchog stsol 'phags ma bcom ldan 'das// lha tshogs rnams la gus pas mchod pa 'bul// bzhes nas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sogs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gnyis kyis bstod/

phan yon tshar gcig bcas dang*/ ri bong can gyi 'od zer 'bum 'phro ba// srid 'gro 'khor ba'i bag chags mun pa bcom// yang dag nges pa'i kun+da grol ba'i gnyen// bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod// phrin las sna tshogs skyob pa'i bdud rtsi'i gter// nyon mongs gdung sel thugs rje'i bsil rgyun 'bebs// chu zla'i gar rol mtha' yas cir yang bsgyur// rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen po// deng 'dir tshogs gnyis sems bskyed dag pa'i sar// byang chub dge ba'i myu gu rgyas pa'i phyir// stan thog 'di ru smin par byin gyis rlobs// zhes bstod nas/ drug pa sngags 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang ldan pa 'od dkar po 'phro ba'i lte bar tām̐/ mdun nas g.yas bskor du/ oṃ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tuta*/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ zhes pas yig 'bru rnams shin tu dkar zhing gsal la 'tsher ba mi g.yo bar gnas pa dang*/ phyi rim lha so so'i sa bon las kyang 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams mchod/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i tshe dpal bsod nams bskyed cing*/ slar 'od zer gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i 'khor 'das kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa'i dwangs ma 'byung ba chen po bzhi yi bcud la sogs pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas/ 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub par gyur bar mos la/ de yang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma bsgom de yi// thugs kar 'khor lo 'od zer dkar// re'u mig brgyad la yi ge ni// brgyad po rnams kyis yongs su gang*// oṃ hā'i yi ge'i dbus gnas pa'i// nye bar bsgrub bya'i ming dang ldan// rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis ni// nges par brtan pos zla drug bsgom// yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// skyo ba med pa'i sems kyis bzlas// oṃ gyi yi ge dang por sbyin// phyi nas tā re rab tu sbyar// de 'og tut+tā re tu re// swā hā'i mtha' can las kun byed// ces gsungs pa ltar sngags 'khor gsal ba bsgom la/

bdun pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes rtsa sngags yig bcu rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di nyis brgya bzlas la/ 'bru brgyad mthar/ ma ma ā yuḥ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig can brgya rtsa bzla'o// brgyad pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo'ang mi gcod par// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan dang*// nad dang dbul ba kun zad byed// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs ni 'jigs par byed// ma slong par ni zas skom sogs// khang bzang gos la sogs pa rnyed// ral gri mig sman rkang byugs dang*// bum bzang la sogs dngos grub rnams// snyan ngag smra mkhan rtsod pa byang*// gcig tu dri med shes rab dang*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub gzhan dag kyang*// 'khor lo 'di las legs par 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// de yang rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum tsho bcu'i grangs bsnyen them pa yin la/ bye ba bzlas pas don thams cad 'grub par bshad do// de nas sgrol ma las thams cad pa'i rigs sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ ma ma kṛ ta/ dzaṃ bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ mo hā ya/ bhan+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes phan yon bskyed pa dang kha skong ba'i phyir bzlas pa bya'o// de yang rgyud las/ 'jig rten la ni dngos gzhan gang*// sngags kyis mi 'grub de yod min// yang dag dad pas 'bad pa las// sngags rnams yid bzhin nor bur mtshungs// zhes so// spyi don gnyis pa bum bskyed bsgrub pa ni las rim bdun yod pa las/ dang po ni/

rnam rgyal bum pa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po dri ma dang bral ba/ lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa ring la mchu 'phyang ba me tog dang lha'i gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam shing los kha brgyan cing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang du lnga phrag lnga ldan gyi rdzas du mas gtams pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sngo la dwangs shing 'khyil ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu yal ga ge sar mchog tu rgyas pa zhes sogs lha tshogs rnams bdag bskyed ltar dmigs nas/ 'od kyi snang bas phyogs bcur khyab par gyur ces pa'i bar dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ las bum gyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi mar hrīḥlas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ dbu skra dmar ser 'bar zhing spyi gtsug tu rta zhal ljang zhur 'tsher ba/ thod skam dang dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa/ sbrul gyi yan lag dkris shing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ khams gsum dbang du sdud cing zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du gsal ba'o// de ltar lha tshogs thams cad dang*/ dpal rta mgrin rnams kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ rang rang gi thugs kar sa bon las 'od zer dkar po dang*/ sna tshogs pa'i 'od dang*/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par du lho phyogs po ṭa la yi zhing khams nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma lha nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhing gi rdul snyed ma lus shing lus pa med pas bskor ba spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

gsum pa spyan 'dren pa dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa ni/ oṃ dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar dag pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa// sgrol ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od las byung ba'i dbang gi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang*/ lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ lha tshogs rnams la rigs lnga so sos rgyas gdab cing*/ dpal rta mgrin la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang*/ de nas bzhi pa mchod pa ni sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gang zhig 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na// dag cing dri med yid 'ong mchod yon 'di// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// bzhes nas zag med bde ba stsal du gsol// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ gang zhig 'jig rten= rnam dag mos blos chu gtsang zhabs bsil 'di// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas= sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pād+yaṃ= gang zhig 'jig rten= lha yi me tog mdzes pa'i dga' tshal 'di// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas= puṣ+pe= gang zhig 'jig rten= ma la ya lung dri zhim ser bus bskyod// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas= dhū pe= gang zhig 'jig rten= ma rig mun gsal mar me gzi 'od 'bar// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas= ā lo ke= gang zhig 'jig rten= ga bur la sogs byugs ba'i rnam pa gang*// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas=

gan+dhe= gang zhig 'jig rten= lha mi'i 'byor ba bcud ldan zhal zas 'di// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i= bzhes nas= nai wi d+ya= gang zhig 'jig rten= dbyangs kyi khyad par sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra// 'phags ma sgrol= bzhes nas= shab+da= zhes brjod la mchod pa'i bye brag rnams 'bul lo// 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul ba ni/ gang zhig 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na// gzugs mchog rnams dang grag stong mi shigs sgra// sbyar dang rang byung dri ngad 'chi med bshos// lha rdzas reg 'jam 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// rgyal srid bkra shis rdzas rtags mchod pa'i tshogs// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs= bzhes nas= oṃ badz+ra rū pa shab+da gan+de rā sa spar+she maṅga la bi shwa pra tīts+tsha ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod la 'bul/ de nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum dang*/ phan yon tshar gcig bklag /de nas thal mo me tog gi snyim pa dang bcas/ rin chen ri bo'i dbus na lhun po dang*// rab mdzes pad+ma'i tshal na 'dab stong can// rnam dag rgyu skar mkha' la zla ba bzhin// rmad byung sems dpa'i dbus na 'phags ma'i sku/ tha snyad brjod pa'i spros pas gos min kyang*// sna tshogs gdul bya'i skad du gcig car du// dag gsal dri med so sor nges pa'i don// legs ston rtsol med kun 'gro 'phags ma'i gsung*// chos rnams kun la mi gnas chos kyi dbyings// rnam dag mngon sum rtogs nas sna tshogs don// ji bzhin gzigs pa dmigs pa med pa'i bdag /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med thugs// rnam 'phrul dpag med mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// rjes su 'dzin mdzad thugs rje'i khyon yangs khyod// gling bzhi'i mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin// tshad med 'gro ba'i don la ngal ma gyur// nam mkha'i lam la nyin mor byed pa dang*// chu gter dbus na lhun po'i dpal bzhin du// 'phags ma'i nang na 'phags ma'i lha mo khyod// bdag gi yid la nye ba nyid du mdzod//

ces rje rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ rnam pa du mas lhag pa'i shes rab kyis// srid zhi'i dpal dang mgon gyur byams pa'i gnyen// 'chi med lha mo nyer gcig skur snang ba// bdag rgyud ye shes mngon gyur byin gyis rlobs// zhes me tog 'thor/ de nas lnga pa yan lag bdun pa tshigs rgyun chags gyis 'bul ba ni/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum gyur 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma nyer gcig dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yab yum sras dang slob ma sprul par bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dud do// mchod pa'i rnam pa du ma zag pa med pa'i rang bzhin can bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i dpal dang 'byor pa'i sprin gyi phung po kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pas bskyed pa'i rab 'byams mtha' yas par rgyas par gang ba'i bla na med pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho ni bzhes par mdzad du gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis thog med dus ring nas da lta la thug gi bar du mi dge'i las ci dang ci bgyid pa thams cad ni so sor bshags so// 'phags pa dang so so'i skye bo'i yang dag pa'i dge ba la ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bdag sogs sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo ni bskor bar bskul lo// zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal ba'i tshul bstan pa'i 'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag ji srid kyi bar du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa ni gsol lo// bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa rnams sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i byang chub snying po'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur yongs su bsngo bar ni bgyi'o// zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas drug pa bum bskyed gyi bzlas par 'jug pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos khar me tog gi phreng ba dang ldan pa'i gzungs rdor bzhag la/

bdag nyid 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa gzungs thag la brgyud de bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i dwangs bcud thams cad bdud rtsi 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ bum lha rnams la thim pas thugs ka'i sngags 'khor dang sku'i cha las 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces bsam la/ yi ge bcu pa sum brgya bzlas la/ spel tshigs can brgya dang lnga bcu/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ rta mgrin sngags kyang bzlas so// bdun pa dung chos kyi chu rgyun mchod pa'i tshul du bum par dbul nas/

oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la phul/ bum pa'i lha rnams bde ba chen por dbyer mi phyed par 'od du zhu nas bum chu'i rang bzhin du gyur/ puṣ+pe la sogs pa nyer spyod lngas mchod/ las bum gyis bsangs gtor byas la/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi las thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ bar chad kyi bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ dpal rta mgrin 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod ba'i rim pa la/ don tshan lnga'i dang po ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su sogs lha tshogs thams cad sngar ltar bskyed la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i bar brjod nas/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas// sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ bar dang*/ oṃ thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten dbang po'i sras mo mchog /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma 'dir gshegs gsol// sgyu 'phrul 'dzin ma khyod kyi sku// chos dang de bzhin longs spyod rdzogs// srid pa kun tu rnam sprul ma// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen yum// don dam phyag rgya chen mo'i sku// gdod nas dri bral gsang chen ma// gnyis med ro mnyam gshegs su gsol// 'gro 'ong med kyang 'gro 'ong ltar// ston mdzad phrin las rgya mtsho'i gter// don gnyis mtha' dag lhun grub ma// thugs rje mnga' ba 'dir gshegs gsol// brjod bral phar phyin shes rab yum// skye 'gag gnas med kun tu khyab// rang rig lhan cig skyes ma dngos// bde stong lha mo 'dir gshegs gsol// mkha' dbyings gang ba'i rnam par rol// ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan ma// dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs// chu shel ston zla'i mdog 'chang zhing*// sna tshogs legs byas 'od zer can// tshur spyon tshur spyon 'phags ma'i tshogs// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ

zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ gsum pa gdan 'bul ba ni/ 'phags ma deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal ba bzang*// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs slad du// 'dir ni gnyis med brtan par bzhugs// snang srid rab 'byams zhing mnyam pa'i// pad+ma 'dab rgyas ge sar bzhad// 'jig rten tshangs dbang brgya byin dang*// lha min la sogs bye ba yis// gtsug gis mngon par 'dud pa'i khri// dwangs shing dad pa'i mos blo yis// ji ltar bde bar 'bul lags na// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs dam tshig sems dpa' gnyis med gcig tu gyur/ bzhi pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+da 'i bar brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len zhing shis pa'i me tog 'thor/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs spyi bor bsten pas gtso bo la 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa dang*/ lha tshogs rnams la rigs lnga so sos rgyas gdab par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas lnga pa mdun bskyed kyi bzlas par 'jug pa ni/

mdun bskyed 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar tām̐ sngags phreng dang bcas pa rtsibs brgyad la yi ge brgyad gsal bar gyur pa las 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyi rim sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las kyang 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs gsal zhing 'tsher ba'i rnam pa du ma phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes kyi chos skyong la sogs pa thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus rtsal yon tan byin rlabs dngos grub dang*/ brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi srid zhi'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi sman rin po che/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa'i nus pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas bdag nyid dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad sogs mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thogs med bde blag tu thob par gyur par mos la rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo yi ge bcu pa bdun brgya dang*/ spel tshig can sum brgya dang lnga bcu bzla/ de nas sgrol ma las thams cad pa'i gzungs sngags kyang bzlas par bya'o// de dag ni mdun bskyed kyi rim pa'o// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba la/ don tshan bcu gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni sngar ltar mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ de dag slar yang mthu bskyed pa'i phyir mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa brjod par bya ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda nā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bid+ya badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ne swā hā/

zhes brjod la/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin zag pa med par 'phro bar mos la/ gnyis pa ni/ mtha' yas zhing khams rab 'byams na// mthon ka'i mdangs can tshangs ral klungs// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon 'di// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ mtha' yas zhing khams rab 'byams na// dal 'bab rgyun bzang mchog tu dwangs// dag byed zhabs bsil dam pa 'di// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pad+yaṃ/ mtha' yas zhing khams= lha yi me tog man+da ra/ pad+ma ku mud skyed mos tshal// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ puṣ+pe/ mtha' yas= a kar tsan+dan du ru ka /dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin chen gtibs// dkyil 'khor= lha tshogs= dhū pe/ mtha' yas zhing khams= snang ba'i sgron me'i rnam pa gang*// 'phrul gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'bar// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= ā lo ke/ mtha' yas zhing khams= dri mchog legs par sbyar ba yi// byugs pa'i dri bsung ngad ldang ba// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= gan+dhe/ mtha' yas zhing khams= sna tshogs bcud kyi khams bsdus pa'i// rmad byung zhal zas yi gar 'ong*// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= nai wi d+ya/ mtha' yas zhing khams= grag stong sgra snyan rol mo dang*// tshangs dbyangs rdo rje'i glu yis bstod// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= shab+da/ zhes sogs phyag rgya dang bcas te dbul zhing*/ gsum pa dpal mo lugs kyi yan lag bdun pa ni/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sogs dang*/ oṃ/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal tā re myur ma dpa' mo// tut+tā re yis 'jigs pa sel ma// tu res don kun byed pa'i sgrol ma// swā hā yi ge khyod la 'dud do// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo//

zhes sogs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun gyis bstod/ lha mo la gus yang dag ldan pa'i// sogs de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi sgrol ma la bstod pa ste rgyud las byung ba byin rlabs khyad par du 'phags pa'o// de nas bzhi pa 'dod yon rnam lnga 'bul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten zhing khams rgya mtsho yi// rdo rje'i gzugs mchog rgyan phreng yid du 'ong*// bla ma bcom ldan dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= rdo rje'i sgra yi bye brag dbyangs snyan ldan// bla ma bcom ldan= bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ shab+da/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= rdo rje dri yi rnam pa kun tu dkrigs// bla ma bcom ldan= bzhes nas= gan+dhe/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= rdo rje ro yi 'dod yon rnam pa gang*// bla ma bcom ldan= bzhes nas= rā sa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= rdo rje'i reg bya dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra// bla ma bcom ldan= bzhes nas= spar+she/ sogs kyang so so'i sngags rgya bcas te 'bul lo// de nas lnga pa ni/ me tog thogs la/ dwangs pa'i yid mtsho'i gnas las thon pa yi// dad pa'i me tog puṇ+ḍā ri ka ni// lhag bsam snyim ba'i lag gi 'khri shing rtser// gus pas mchod pa'i rten du 'bul lags na// thugs rje byams pa'i dbyings nas nyer dgongs la// bla med mchog gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te puṣ+pa ke tu rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pe uta bha we/ puṣ+pe saṃ bha we/ puṣ+pe a ba ki ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis mngon par bsngags nas me tog 'bul na/ ji snyed pa de snyed kyi me tog bye bar phul ba'i 'gyur gyi gzungs sngags byin rlabs dang ldan pas 'bad pas zungs shig

/de nas drug pa yan lag lnga pa'i smon lam ni thal mo me tog snyim pa sbyar nas/ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// dug gsum dbang gyur nongs pa'i tshogs// 'phags ma'i lha tshogs mkhyen gzigs ldan// spyan sngar so sor bshags par bgyi// bder gshegs 'phags pa byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal 'gro rnams kyi// bsam gtan bzlas brjod dge ba'i stobs// bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams bzhugs pa yi// ston pa sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// chos 'khor rtag tu bskor bar bskul// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams// ma grol 'khor ba las sgrol phyir// bskal pa zhing rdul ji snyed par// 'tsho zhing gzhes par gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad// byang chub mngon du legs byas nas// sems can thams cad bder 'god shog / ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de nas bdun pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrol mar bstod pa mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ni/ oṃ/ dge ba ma ni gzi brjid can// 'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che// sogs rgyud nas byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dag gis kyang bstod par bya'o// de nas brgyad pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// zhes sogs/ mchod pa'i yan lag skabs su me tog 'thor/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// bar bton nas/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal rdul phyi ba dang dri'i thig le dgod pa dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod la/ me tog tshom bu so sor 'god bzhin pas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ rin po che gser gyi sa gzhi'i khor yug brdal ba'o// oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje'i ri yi mu khyud kyi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐ srung pa'i rang bzhin 'od zer 'bar ba/

oṃ ham̐ su me ra we na maḥ dbus su ri yi rgyal po ri dbang lhun po mchog rab/ oṃ yam̐ pū ru bi de ha ya na maḥ shar lus 'phags po/ oṃ ram̐ dzam̐ pu dwī pā ya na maḥ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ oṃ lam̐ a pa ra go dā nī yā ya na maḥ nub ba lang spyod/ oṃ wam̐ ut+ta ra ku ra we na maḥ byang sgra mi snyan/ oṃ yam̐ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ yam̐ u pa dwī pa ya na maḥ lus dang lus 'phags/ oṃ ram̐ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ ram̐ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ oṃ lam̐ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ lam̐ u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ oṃ wam̐ u pā dwī pa ya na maḥ oṃ wam̐ u pa dwī pa ya na maḥ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan kyi zla/ oṃ sur+yā yā ya na maḥ gsal byed shes rab kyi nyi ma/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ya na maḥ snang byed thabs kyi zla ba/ gzhan yang srid zhi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rab 'byams mchod ba'i sprin rgya mtshos yongs su gang ba 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs sras dang slob mar bcas pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi dkon mchog rin po che rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ thugs brtse ba chen po'i dbyings nas nye bar dgos te zhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad rgyu tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang*/ dngos grub kyi mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol/ zhes me tog 'thor/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i ri rab la sogs rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams dpag yas rdo rje'i rgyun gyi phreng ba ldan// rdo rje'i maṇ+ḍal bla na med pa'i bkod pa 'di// rdo rje sgrol ma'i lha tshogs ma lus 'khor bcas la// mchog tu dad pas kun tu bdag 'bul byin gyis rlobs// me tog 'thor zhing*/ oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul lo// de nas dgu pa ni/

glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tut+tā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+ma yi// ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgya ut+pa la// bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tut+ta re// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni// 'jig rten thams cad skyob bar mdzad// kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'ang ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa de yis bstod la spos dang rol mo 'bul lo// de nas bcu pa rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i 'dod gsol yan lag bdun pa ni/

bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la phyag 'tshal nas// mchod pa rnam pa du mas rab mchod de// nyes gsum mthar byed khyod kyi spyan snga 'dir/ sdig pa mtha' dag bshags shing bsdom par bgyi// 'gro ba'i dge legs kun la dga' bskyed de// srid zhi'i kun tu bcom ldan 'das ma khyod// rab bde bla med chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rtag par bskor bas mtha' dag tshim par gsol// nam yang khyod tshul nub med bka' drin dang*// dge kun khyod nyid kho na'i rgyur gsol zhing*// dge legs snying po'i dpal 'bras khyod dang bdag /rnam pa kun tu mi phyed nyid gyur cig / ces brjod la me tog 'thor/ de nas bcu gcig pa rgyal srid sna bdun sogs 'bul ba ni/ dzam+bu'i gser las rang byung ba'i// rtsibs stong mu khyud rab mnyam ldan// mkha' la mngon par 'phags pa yi// 'khor lo rin chen 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nyin mor byed pa'i 'od ldan zhing*// dgos 'dod bsam pa kun 'byung ba'i// lha lam mdangs 'dzin bai ḍūr+ya// nor bu rin chen 'bul= oṃ ma ṇi rat+na= shes rab rang bzhin lang tshos gang*// sgyu 'phrul sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan// reg bya mchog gi dud pa yi// btsun mo rin chen= oṃ s+t+ri rat+na= zab cing rgya che gting dpag dka'// phur bu'i blo ldan yid gzhungs pa// phan bde'i dpyid gyur gtong phod can// blon po rin chen= /oṃ pu ru ṣa= stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs chu zhing gab// thal dkar mche ba drug ldan pa// kai la sha yi kha dog can// glang po rin chen= oṃ hasti rat+na= rlung gi shugs 'chang gom stabs kyis// 'khor yug bskor te slar ldog pa// rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i spu sdug mdzes// rta mchog rin chen= oṃ tu raṅga a shwa rat+nā= dpa' zhing rngams pa'i dregs pa yis// bdud bzhi'i phas rgol mthar byed pa'i// khams gsum dbang bsgyur snying stobs 'chang*// dmag dpon rin chen=

oṃ khaṅga rat+na= zhes dang*/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ lha rdzas gdugs bzang nor bu dril g.yer 'phyangs// gser mig dang ldan nya mo 'gyur zhing 'khyug /dri med 'dab stong pad+ma ge sar can// g.yas 'khyil skye ba lnga pa chos sgra sgrogs// rin chen bum pa dpag bsam 'byung gnas gter// dpal gyi be'u dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra// phyogs las rnam grol mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng*// zlum 'khyil 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud mdzes// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul// oṃ aṣ+ṭa he tu maṅga la pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes 'bul zhing*/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni/ rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum gyur lha yi tshogs// dkyil 'khor chen por don dam de bzhin mchod// kun rdzob rten 'brel smon lam khyad par gyi// bkra shis rmad byung rdzas kyi bye brag ni// yungs kar bgegs 'joms mthu stobs nus par ldan// durbas tshe 'phel 'chi med rdo rje 'grub// li khris dbang bsgyur chos kyi rgyal srid brtan// gi'u waṃ dug gsum nad bcom nyon mongs zhi// rtsi bcud dwangs mas bkra shis yon tan bskyed// me long sgrib bral snying po'i don rtogs shing*// bil bas don 'grub byang chub 'bras bu smin// dung dkar sa gsum grags snyan ldir bar byed// shis pa'i rdzas mchog 'bul ba'i bsod nams kyis/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing dpal dang 'byor ba rgyas// tshe dbang ye shes 'gyur med gzhom bral brtan// yid la 'dod 'jo'i dngos grub char chen stsol// oṃ aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ dra bya pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes 'bul nas/ de nas bcu gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bstod pa tshigs bcad brgyad pa ni/ seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang*// lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams// zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// khyod kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma gnyis la ni// yan lag mchog gis rab tu gtugs gyur na// mngon 'dod bde ba'i 'bras bu smin mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la=

'dab ma brgyad ldan yangs pa'i snying po ni// gser zhun nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra zhing*// rdul bral ston ka'i zla ltar dri ma med// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= drang srong gtso dang grub pa lto 'phye che// gshin rje srin po gnod sbyin lha min dang*// lha tshogs rnams kyi zhabs la phyag byas pa'i// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= gling dang nags tshal stug po ri khrod dang*// phug dang chu klung ri bo'i rtse rnams su// dus rnams kun tu bzhugs par gyur pa yi// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= seng ge stag dang glang po mtsho chen dang*// me dang 'ching ba rkun po sbrul dug gi /gnod pa thams cad rab tu 'joms mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= tā re tut+ta re dang tu re yis// g.yul gyi mtshon cha bzlog mdzad phan par dgongs// 'jigs dang rmi lam ngan pa 'joms mdzad ma// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la= thugs rjes non pa'i thabs kyis gang dang gang*// sems can gzigs gyur de yi dpal 'phel 'gyur// sgrol mas mi bslu'i 'bras bu myur thob mdzod// bcom ldan sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/ thal mo me tog gi snyim par sbyar la/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// sogs kyis 'dod gsol phul nas/ skabs su me tog 'thor bar bya'o// de ltar mchod cing bstod pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs rnams rab tu dgyes nas/ sgrub pa po dang*/ gang gi don du bya ba de yi spyi bor mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas reg ste dngos grub kyi mchog stsol bar bsam mo// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni/ don bzhi las dang po byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor cir yang 'char ba bla na med pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyed par byed pa'i kha dog dri ro nus pa mtha' klas pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gnyis pa bstod cing 'bul ba ni/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang gi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char// srid zhi'i tshogs gnyis bskyed pa'i gnyen// don gnyis 'bras bu ster ba mo// 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams la bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyi// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// bar brjod/ gsum pa 'dod don gsol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ grub pa chen po brgyad dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang mngon spyod kyi phrin las la sogs pa thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub nas 'gro ba'i don nus par mdzad du gsol/ sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las byung ba'i 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug la sogs pa nad gdon bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba'i gnod byed thams cad phyir bzlog cing med par mdzad du gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byings pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod par mdzad du gsol/ dus kun tu yang bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang dpung gnyen skyabs dam par mdzad nas thugs brtse ba chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ khyad par 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa de nyid gsol ba rtse gcig tu gdab po// bzhi pa phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ sngon 'gro'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar btang nas bgegs bskrad srung 'khor gyi bar bya zhing*/

de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul gnyis las don skabs thob so sor phye ba las rim pa bcu yod pas/ dang po ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs las bum gyi khrus dang maṇ+ḍal sogs phul la smin par bya ba'i rim pa 'og tu bkod par ltar rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhan slob ma gzhug pa dang 'brel bar thog mar bgegs dang bar chad bsal ba'i don du/ sngon 'gro sbyong khrus kyi rim pa spro na/ slob ma rnams gus pa dang bcas drung du 'khod la/ stegs kyi khar zlum gtor gsum dang changs bu ting lo gsum re bcas spel mar bshams la/ a kā ra ོ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba bigh+naṃ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma rnams slob mar g.yas bskor lan gsum dang se gol bcas bya'o// gang 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs zhi bas sbyang bar 'os pa rnams tshim par gyis la rang gnas su song zhig / ces btang*/ slar yang changs bu ting lo g.yon bskor sogs sngar bzhin/ sarba bigh+nāṃ dang rdo rje gsor la/ sum+bha ni spel mar lan gsum brjod la/ gang 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bar 'os pa rnams tshim par gyis la rang rang gi gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro ba de dag rdo rje'i me lces brlag par 'gyur ro// zhes pas btang*/ de nas rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis dril stabs dang bcas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir slob ma smin par byed// khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// oṃ badz+ra kro dha

sogs dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang rdo rje gsor la gu gul bdug yungs kar gyis brab la bgegs bskrad/ de nas gsum pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mdun du til dang*/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag la/ khyed rang gi snying gar kaṃ nag po sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo sha za'i gzugs su gnas pa la/ lte ba nas hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas ded de sna bug g.yas nas thon mdun gyi til la thim pas khro bo'i zhal du song bar mos shig oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ mtheb srin gyis blangs nas gyen du phyogs pa steng 'og brje zhing g.yas g.yon du lan gsum bskor te/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs/ g.yon du rgya mtsho chen por dor bas byang zhing dag par gyur par bsams la mer bsreg chur blug ste phyir dor ro// de nas bzhi pa bkru byab bsrung ba'i rim pa bstan par bya ba ni/ de yang rnam rgyal chen pos rgyun gyi khrus gsol ba la phan yon dpag tu med pa thob par 'gyur gsungs bzhin lha khrus sogs mi dgos shing 'di skad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa ji lta bar gsal ba bkra lam mer bzhugs pa dang*/ khyad par du mtshan gtso bum lag tu thogs la mchan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam rgyal chen po'i bum pa 'di phyi rin po che las grub pa/ nang lha yi 'khor lor zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa las dkar zhing bsil ba reg na bde ba'i chu rgyun 'bab pas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par phyir thon nas lus shel gong g.ya' phyis ba ltar gsal stong sgrib med dwangs shing 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can du song bar mos shig / brjod la dang po kha bshal/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/

spro na so sor spel tshig can spyi 'gro lta bu dang*/ bsdu na/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar chad grib dang mi gtsang ba dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba pha rol gyi byad dang phur kha rbod gtong mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad shin+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes long skabs dang bstun la brjod/ de nas byab pa ni bsgrub bya'i gzugs khrus chur 'char bar byas shing*/ bum chu khar bzung du bcug la/ bum pa'i kha rgyan rtse gsum gyi rgyas bzung la/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ dkar po'i mthar nye snying gis bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs dang 'od dkar po'i zer 'phros nas khyed rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar khrus chu'i nang du sib sib thim par mos shig / ces nye snying mthar spel tshig rgyas bsdus gong ltar skabs dang bstun la/ a pā na ye swā hā btags pa brjod cing byab par bya'o// mthar kha bshal/ de nas srung ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la rdo rje dang ut+pala'i srung ba'i rang bzhin gyis mi shigs par rgyas gdab/ mi 'gyur bar brtan par bya ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i sogs brjod la/ rdo rje spyi mgrin snying lte gsang ba dpung pa gnyis dpyi gnyis pus mo gnyis sogs la rgya gram bkod pa'i tshul du bzhag la/ nye snying dang gong ltar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa btags pa brjod/ de ltar sngon du 'gro ba bkru byab srung ba'i rim pa la brten nas/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ zhes brjod par bya'o// de ltar khrus byab srung gsum gyi spel tshig bsdus pa re re nas brgya rtsa brgyad kyi grangs ldan byas nas khrus brgya zhar la 'grub pa'o// de nas lnga pa dbang dngos la 'jug pa ni/

maṇ+ḍal gzhung las byung ba'am ci rigs pa phul la/ sngon chad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ma zhugs pa'am/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs mtshon pa'i brdar ras yug dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa re'i gdong g.yogs 'ching ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha sogs kyis gdong g.yogs bcings/ dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i phyag rten du me tog gi phreng ba re gtad par mos shig / ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ me tog gtad/ de nas thal mo me tog dang bcas te slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i drung du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal//

lan gsum dang*/ snying gar byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du stong nyid ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa re bsgom la rjes zlos/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ lan gsum/ rdo rje snying gar reg la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ de nyid snying po'i bar du byang chub kyi sems rab tu brtan par bya'o// de nas bdun rnam par dag pa rdo rje gur las byung ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum dang*/ rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa dam tshig rnams ji lta bar bsrung ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas dam la bzhag pa'i rim pa bzhi las dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ dus 'di nyid du khyod nyid ni// sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na// nga yis ye shes rdo rje sbyin// de yis rgyas par 'grub par 'gyur// nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje snying gar reg la/ nga yis bstan pa'i gsang sngags 'di// dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams la// gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ tsan+dan dang gur gum bsres pas bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i chu sbyin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'byung*// ci ste dam las 'gal gyur na// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// slob dpon bka' gnyan par gdams pa'i dam bzhag ni/ thal mo spyi bor bkod/ deng nas brtsams te nga yi bka'// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*// dam tshig 'gal bar mi bya ste// de nas dam la gnas par gyis// des yol ba phyi 'jug gi rim pa rnams song nas/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshul la thog mar ye shes dbab pa'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos thal mo sbyar la/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la bdag la ye shes sems dpa' dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ de nas drug pa ye shes dbab pa'i don du dmigs pa gsal btab pa ni/ slob ma rnams snang ba mtha' yas su gsal ba'i rkang mthil du yam̐ las rlung dkyil sngon po zla gam ba dan yam̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ gsang bar ram̐ las me dkyil dmar po 'bar ba dang dzhiṃ gis mtshan pa/ snying khar yam̐ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi rgya gram dang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pam̐ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po bum pa dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung dkyil sngon po ba dan dang ham̐ mgo thur bstan gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sa g.yos/ chu khol bas ham̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus thams cad gang zhing snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa/ mtha' mar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rtsa sngags me 'bar ba'i rnam pa bzhin dmar lhag lhag par bsgom la/ lha tshogs rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa gyis shig / rol mo bsgrag cing spos 'thul la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re dz+nyā na badz+ra a be sha ya a be sha ya āḥ.āḥ zhes mang du brjod pas byin 'bebs par byas la/ de nyid dbyer med du rgyas gdab par mos la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje spyi bor bzhag /de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la spo ba'i tshul gyis ched du brjod pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// de nas slob ma rnams gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor du gsol ba btab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi//

zhes brjod/ sngon tshe sbyong ba'i rigs kyi lha brtag pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor du me tog 'dor ba ni/ rin chen me tog la sogs pa// gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi lha// gtso bo rigs te bsgrub nas ni// dngos grub myur te the tshom med// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes phul la de nyid spyi bor bstim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar gyis// pra ti gṛh+na swa i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bkod/ ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang mig dar lhan cig bsal ba'i mos pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ya hūm̐/ ces rdo rje dang bcas te mig dar bsal/ dkyil 'khor la blta ba bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// zhes dkyil 'khor la blta ba bskul nas/ mngon rtogs bzhin ngo sprad la/ ྃ ྂ ྃ de ltar 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum mjal bar mos la/ spro ba bskyed nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// gsang sngags rnams la'ang brtson par gyis// de nas 'jug pa'i chos rnams song nas dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas bdun pa dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par zhu ba'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// de ltar yon tan 'byung ba sogs// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig / lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur ba ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ spyi bor bzhag la bum chu btung*/ de ltar kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi dri ma bkrus nas me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la smin par gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyis rin po che las grub pa'i rigs lnga'i mtshon byed cod pan gyi dbang bskur pa ni/ cod pan thogs la/ phal pa'i gzhi ni gzhom pa dang*// yon tan gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyir// nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan gyi// cod pan gyis ni dbang bskur ro/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra hūm̐/ rat+na tram̐/ pad+ma hrīḥ karma āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ rat+na ma la tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes spyi bor bkon/ de ltar nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi ye shes lngar mtshon pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyod la bskur// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lag g.yas su gtad/ de ltar yid kyi dri ma dag nas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la smin par gyur/ deng nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi stong nyid kyi rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang bskur pa ni/ dril bu thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ lag g.yon par byin la bkrol/ de ltar sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi dri ma dag /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo dril thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje'i ming dbang khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta hūm̐/

rdo rje'i gsang mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// de dag ni slob ma'i dbang ste/ de nas brgyad pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ khyed rnams dpal rdo rje sems dpar sgoms shig /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phyag na rdo rje'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brten// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra e ṣa dha ra yā mi hūm̐/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ rdo rje lan gsum gsor nas snying gar bzung la rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin par mos shig /de nas dgu pa bzlas lung sbyin pa ni/ khyed rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ dkar po sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal thob la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng mu tig gi phreng ba ltar 'phros nas slob ma'i zhal du zhugs thugs kar 'khod par mos la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ lan gsum brjod du gzhug la/ me tog 'thor la rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de nyid spyi bor 'ching bar mos la/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// me tog spyi bor bkod la/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don sgrub bar byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang bcas te rim bzhin phyag rgyas bcings la/ ji ltar 'jig rten ma lus pa// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul ba'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// de bzhin du/ rdo rje= rin chen= pad+ma= rgya gram= sogs sbyar la/ bcu pa ni/ des dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang rdzogs par thob nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig tshul bzhin 'dzin snyam pas rjes zlos/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba ni/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum rjes zlos dang*/ mthar shis brjod dang*/ dge ba bsngos nas slob ma rnams gyes/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga gtang rag gi mchod pa bya ba ni/ don bdun las/ dang po ni mchod pa rnams kha gso/ sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ 'gro kun re re'ang zhing rdul lus sprul nas// yid 'ong rmad byung mchod yon mar gyur te// mchod yon rnam dag mkha' dbyings gang ba yangs// 'khor ba ji srid mchod par 'bul gyis bzhes// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar/ zhabs bsil= pād+yaṃ= me tog= puṣ+pe= bdug spos= dhū pe= snang gsal= a lo ke= dri chab= gan+dhe= zhal zas= nai wi d+ya= sgra snyan= shab+da= zhes sogs brjod la rol chen bya/ de nas gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal tā re sogs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod/ spro na/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol ta re ma// sogs nas/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog / ces pa'i bar brjod/ de nas gsum pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ 'phags ma sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa sprul pa'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams zhabs pad brtan zhing rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

khyad par du bdag cag rnal 'byor pa rgyu sbyor ba sbyin pa'i bdag po yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi rkyen phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du grub par mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thogs med bde blag nyid du tshe 'di nyid la stsol bar byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ bzhi pa bzod gsol ni/ yi ge brgya bas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs dang*/ gshegs gsol byed na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// sogs nas/ badz+ra muḥ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par mos/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gtang ba ni/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir sogs brjod/ de nas lnga pa rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i tām̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i gur khang la thim/ rang nyid kyang rim gyis thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim/ de'ang thig le dang nā da mi dmigs pa'i ngang las rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o// zhes pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag la/ slar rang nyid rje btsun ma yi skur lam gyis gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ snang srid kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa stong bzhin du ye shes lha yi dkyil 'khor du gsal bar gyur/ drug pa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs/ dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs smon lam gyi rgyas gdab la/ de nas dkyil 'khor rjes bsdu ni/ rdul tshon yod na/ a kā ro sa chos thams cad skye ba med par yid la byas te rim bzhin bsdus te rjes mi mngon par byas la/ bdun pa shis pa brjod pa ni/

me tog gi char pa snyil bzhin pas/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' dbyings khyon yangs por// gsang gsum rgyan gyi yon tan rab dwangs pa'i// mtha' dbus med pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho gyur cig /bla med dkon mchog dam pa nyin mo'i mgon// rnam dag thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'od stong gis// 'jig rten mun sel bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho gyur cig /yid bzhin 'khor lo nor bu chu shel can// 'gro la bdud rtsi'i dpal ster yum gyur ma// 'chi med mchog sbyin bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal= 'phags ma nyer gcig phrin las gang 'dul gyi// 'od snang dkar pos phyogs bcur khyab pa yi// nyon mongs gdung sel bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal= lha dang bcas pa'i mchod 'os gtsug gi rgyan// bstan 'dzin dge 'dun skar tshogs lta bur rgyas// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal gyis= 'jig rten mes po tshangs dang brgya byin dbang*// stobs kyi dpung tshogs legs byas char chen gyi// phyogs las rnam rgyal bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal gyis= srid zhi'i phun tshogs yongs 'du'i dpag bsam ljon// bsod nams bye ba'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i// 'dod dgu smin pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// deng 'dir dge ba'i dpal gyis 'tsho gyur cig /

ces shis pa brjod pa gzhan yang ci rigs pa spel bar bya'o// de ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di yi dang po spyi sgrub la bsnyen pa legs par byas la/ de nas lha nyer gcig po so so'i las tshogs man ngag rnams rgya gzhung nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin sgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// de ltar tshul 'dir mos pa'i blo can bslab gsum ldan pa stong nag pa'i sku skye phun tshogs rab brtan gyi rnam par dag pa'i rgyud kyis nye bar bslangs nas 'di ltar dgos zhes rten 'byung gi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bstan 'gror sman pa dang bde ba'i phyir gsal bar bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro rnams 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang mngon du reg par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ su dza yan+tu/// / ༈ 'don 'grigs bkod pa bzhugs/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig cho ga sgrub mchod dang*/ sku rim lta bu'i skabs/ dang por tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ bsam pa lhun grub ma/ de nas brgyud 'debs dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung bdag bskyed dang*/ bum bskyed mdun bskyed rnams la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bton skabs thal mo sbyar la/ phyag 'tshal tā re myur ma sogs maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa ltar/ gnyis dang*/ gsum bdun gyi grangs la/ phan yon tshar re dang*/ bsnyen pa'i grangs gzhung du gsal// mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab mtshams tshogs thengs bya/ yar 'tshogs bsnyen pa dang*/ mchod pa/ gtor 'bul/ sngon 'gro btang zhing*/ khrus byab dmigs bsal dgos na bya/ de man 'dir mi dgos shing*/ bdag 'jug byin rlabs kyi ched du bya zhing*/ rjes zlos rnams tshar res 'thus/ byin 'bebs skabs rol tshig dkyil chog gzhan ltar dgos/ rol mo spyi la mchod rol dgos pa dang*/ grol nyin lta bu dang*/ slob mar dbang gi skabs la rjes zlos gsum re dgos/

dbang gi nang yig chung thams cad rgyun par 'don mi dgos shing*/ dbang gnang skabs slob dpon gyis mtshams sbyor gsung rgyu yig chung ser yod bzhag /yig chung ser med 'don rgyu dang*/ cho ga 'di nyin re tshar gnyis 'don tshe/ gong ltar mchod pa byin rlabs nas skyabs 'gro tshar gcig 'don la tshogs pa gung gseng bya/ de nas yar 'tshogs skyabs 'gro lan gnyis dang bcas sngar ltar mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab mtshams tshogs thengs dang*/ yar 'tshogs bsnyen pa mchod pa gtor 'bul bya/ sngon 'gro mi dgos/ bdag 'jug dang rjes chog bya// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dril gsil bya/ bkra shis smon lam sogs mtha' rgyas spel legs mdzad pas grub pa'o// maṅga lam su dza yan+tu/// / ༈ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gnas skabs su 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dpal rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang bcas te/ legs par gsan 'tshal/ de yang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams ni sems can gyi don la thabs mkhas shing thugs rjes lhag par brtse ba'i phyir/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas kun gyi byin mthu'i gong bu smin pa 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'jig rten khams thams cad sgrol ba'i phyir du/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar sngon gnyis su dngos su snang ba'i sku yi bkod pa dang*/ de las kyang mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du 'phags ma nyer gcig la sogs pa gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las rlabs po che 'byams su klas pa'i spyod pa gzhal bar dka' ba dag mchis par snang zhing*/ da lam skabs su babs pa ni/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i lugs kyi sgrol dkar 'chi med dpal ster gtso bor byas te/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i bzhed pa sgrol ma nyer gcig sor bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsar du bkod cing*/

rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs su gtogs par byas/ lar 'di yi dkyil chog gi dbang gzhung mi tra brgya rtsa'i gral la bzhugs pas/ spyan ras gzigs dngos snang dpal karma pa bcu gsum pa'i drung nas thob cing*/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs rin 'byung la yang rig gtang rjes gnang tsam snang ba'i rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po'i drung nas legs par thob pa ste/ de ltar smin dbang grol byed gdams pa'i tshan kha ma nyams pa byin rlabs khyad par du 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma nyer gcig gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa la/ thog mar slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun bum pa sgrub pa sogs ma nor bar sngon du song zin nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i sngon 'gro sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i don du dngos dang yid sprul rgya mtshos drangs ba'i maṇ+ḍal gnang 'tshal/ ྃ ྂ ྃ de'ang rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ zla ba chu shel dkar pos gzhal yas/ de'i dbus su pad dkar sdong bu yal 'dab rgyas pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i lte bar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma dkar mo/ spyan bdun bkra zhing*/ dbu skra mthon mthing ltag par bcings shing*/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyur pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan cha mgul chu do shal la sogs rgyan du mas spras pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mtheb srin sbyar bas ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang sna tshogs dar gyi smad g.yogs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ de'i phyi rim pad 'dab bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rim pad 'dab bdun/ de'i phyir rim pad 'dab bcu rnams kyi steng du pad nyi zla gdan so sor/ mdun du sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo/

dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma dkar mo/ gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma ser mo/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal sgrol ma ser mo/ hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa'i sgrol ma ser mo/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal sgrol ma dmar mo/ rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma nag mo/ dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ser mo/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ljang sngon/ mya ngan med pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma nag mo/ bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ser mo/ yongs su smin pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma mthing ga /dge legs ster ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma dmar mo/ bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ sdug bsngal sel ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma dmar ser/ yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo/ de rnams kyang rgyan lugs sna tshogs pa sku'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal zhing 'od kyi snang bas phyogs bcur khyab par mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/// / ༈ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi /zin bris mthong ba don ldan bzhugs// swasti/ 'phags ma nyer gcig dkyil chog dus phyis 'dir// sgrub dang mchod pa'i srol rgyun dben pas na// bslab gsum mngon mtho stong sprul phun tshogs brtan// rnam dag mos blos kun bslang lha rdzas dang*// 'phags ma'i sku brnyan dzam+bu chu gser las// grub pa dang bcas bskul bas don yod phyir// gzhung mthun gong ma dag gis gsung rgyun gyis// brgyan pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos tshul tsam bkod// bdag lta so skye'i cal sgrog 'bras med par// des na gzur gnas yid brtan dka' gyur mod// 'on kyang 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang sras mo// sprul bsgyur nyer gcig sgrub thabs 'di dag rnams// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyud gsungs bzhin// nā gā rdzu na a ti sha la sogs// 'phags yul paṇa grub rim gnyis rten thob gzhi// dkyil chog rgya gzhung bod 'dir snga rabs su// sa skya dkar po rnam gsum thugs dam mthil// gzhan yang ris med mkhas grub spyi nor te// dar rgyas che la byin rlabs yid ches gnas// rtsod med lha sngags mchog gyur gzh-ir grub pa// smos ma dgos par bstan cing cho ga yi// /paṇa chen nyi sbas lugs te grub chen rje// mi tra dzo ki'i thugs dam brgya rtsar grags// rje btsun tā ra nā thas kun btus kyi// sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs dang 'brel ba yi// lha sngags zhal phyag dbye tshul ji bzhin par// bkod la zur tsam khyad par snang ba ni// de yang dgu par seng ldeng nags sgrol ljang*// phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang ni rgol 'joms sgrol// na bza' ser bsnams zhes pa stod g.yogs tshul// rab rgyas sgrol ma glegs bam ut+pal mtshan// bkra shis snang sgrol lcags kyu gnyis bsnams sogs// yig cha khungs ldan rnams su gsal ba bzhin// de ltar 'du bgyis 'khrul dris ma gos snyam// 'di nyid sgrub par spro na dmigs rten du// 'phags ma'i sku dang mchod pa gtor ma bshams// gtsang sbra dkar spyad dang bcas mtshams bcad la// dang po sngon 'gro nas bzung srung 'khor bsgom// mchod byin brlab dang skyabs sems tshogs zhing mchod// bdag lhar bskyed da nga dam ye bsre dbang bskur// rgyas gdab mchod bstod bya zhing 'di skabs su// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig rjes la bzhag bzlas dmigs// gsal gdab bsten pa tshad sbyar 'bum phrag bcu'i// grangs bsnyen them zhing bye ba bzlas pa yis// las kun 'grub gsungs spel tshig tshe sham can// brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas spyi bo'i 'od dpag med// phyag gis lhung bzed bdud rtsi khol babs nas// rang lus gang dmigs 'chi med 'grub par bsam// las sngags skabs bstun bzlas la thun mtshams su// 'og nas 'byung bzhin gtor 'bul mchod pa'i rjes// bstod phyag nyer gcig gnyis gsum bdun gyi grangs// thun rnams so sor grangs nges brjod de yang*// rang gzhan bcud kyi sems can dang snod kyi// 'byung lnga'i khams las rang sgra sgrogs nas su// phyag bstod phul bsam mdun rten lha'i phyag g.yas// mchog sbyin rang ngam dmigs bya'i spyi bor bzhag

/byin rlabs gang gsol 'bad med lhun grub mos// de nas lha dang lha min sogs 'dod gsol// yig brgyas kha bskang rten bzhugs bsdu rim bya// zung 'jug skur snang dge bsngo shis pa brjod// de bzhin thun bcad sngon gtor nyin ltar du// mi dgos mchod pa byin rlabs phyin dkyus mtshungs// bsnyen sgrub grol khar spro na bum mdun bskyed// la sogs gzhung ltar bsnyen pa'i bcu cha yi// kha bskang bya tshul kho bos zin btab pa// rgyal dbang bcu gsum mchog gis mdzad sgrol ma// bkra shis don 'grub rgyas pa'i sreg blugs thabs// der gsal lha sngags sgyur tsam khyad par gda'// gzhan yang nyer gcig so so'i sgrub las sbyor// bya bar 'dod na paṇa chen nye sras lugs// badz+re shwa ras bkral ba des mngon zhing/// / ༈ tshogs bsags sgrub mchod rim pa spro ba la// rten mchod bshams bkod gzhung mthun sngon gtor nas// bdag bum mdun bskyed so sor bstod phyag grangs// nges can bzlas pa'i grangs kyang de'i rigs 'gre// mchod phreng rdzogs nas dbang gi sngon gtor dang*// srung 'khor bdag 'jug la sogs gzhung ltar gyi// khrus chog dmigs bsal can las 'dir mi bya// dbang chog mi tra'i bzhed ltar bkod rang gzhan// don chen phan yon thob phyir rgyud sde'i gsung*// byang chub snying po'i 'bras gang smin pa'i gzhi// de ltar yongs la sman cing phan bde'i ched// pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa ste// 'gal 'khrul mthol bshags dge gang mchis pa des// rgyal bstan yun gnas bstan 'dzin zhabs pad brtan// dge 'dun sde rgyas 'gro rnams bde skyid ldan// srid zhi las grol thar chen mchog thob shog /sarba maṅga lam̐/// /
